style.backgroundSystem: frosted glass-brick countertop and a shallow haze blue-grey wall, clean and prop-free, depth kept shallow
style.iconSystem: thin #E6E23A square outline frame with exactly one vertical bar centered inside it, uniform 2px stroke, flat, unfilled, no gradient, no shadow
style.lightingSystem: single high-position 6000K soft key from upper front-left, high key, short sharp contact shadows, crisp micro-specular on etched glass, cool clean mood
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: cool haze-blue-grey baby-care ecommerce system; fixed palette of haze blue-grey #8A9BA8, frosted glass-brick grey-white #DCE4E8, pure white #FFFFFF with ink-grey #2B3339 text and one lemon-yellow accent #E6E23A; cool 6000K high-key lighting from upper front-left with short sharp contact shadows and crisp micro-specular on etched glass; frosted glass-brick countertop; modern geometric sans-serif; thin lemon-yellow square-outline icons containing one centered vertical bar; stable centered product scale, plumb verticals, real contact shadows; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: keep text #2B3339 and the single accent #E6E23A
no warm or neutral color temperature; stay cool 6000K
no long, soft or warm-cast shadows
no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon type
no filled, gradient or multi-bar icons; square outline plus one vertical bar only
no background material other than frosted glass brick
no brand, wordmark, logo, watermark, QR code, price, discount or membership badge
no numeric specs, age range, certification, ingredient claim or medical statement
no baby shown unaccompanied, face-forward or in an identifiable likeness
no floating product and no missing contact shadow
